subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Utilizar o presente do indicativo para identificar pessoas (verbo to be) e descrever rotinas diárias.

components.description_pt: Usar o verbo 'ser' no tempo presente simples para identificar pessoas
components.description_en: Use the verb 'to be' in the simple present tense to identify people
components.cc_component_description: Match a singular noun with the correct present-tense verb form in a basic sentence

components.description_pt: Descrever rotinas diárias usando verbos em presente simples com precisão
components.description_en: Describe daily routines using simple present tense verbs accurately
components.cc_component_description: Use present-tense verbs correctly to describe current actions in writing

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre usos do presente simples para identificação e descrição de rotina
components.description_en: Distinguish between uses of simple present tense for identification and routine description
components.cc_component_description: Form the simple present tense of verbs correctly in sentences

cc_matches.description: Use singular and plural nouns with matching verbs in basic sentences (e.g., He hops; We hop).
Use verbs to convey a sense of past, present, and future (e.g., Yesterday I walked home; Today I walk home; Tomorrow I will walk home).
Form and use the simple (e.g., I walked; I walk; I will walk) verb tenses.
